caption: The video showcases an extreme close-up of two or three bright yellow lemon wedges submerged in a clear liquid, their pale white pith edges forming diagonal bands against a dark background. The textured rinds are densely carpeted with tiny spherical gas bubbles that cling to every groove and pore of the fruit. Across the excerpt this clinging coat stays broadly intact, with the individual spheres showing little visible growth or detachment. The only clear motion comes from a few loose bubbles drifting slowly through the dark fluid at the left edge and in the gaps between wedges. The lemon slices themselves remain essentially fixed in the frame, so the visible activity is confined to the surrounding liquid rather than the rind's bubbled surface. Shallow focus softens some of the larger spheres into bright bokeh while keeping the central wedge sharply detailed. The clip captures this quiet, persistent effervescence without showing how the carbonation began or when it subsides.

draft_caption: The video showcases an extreme close-up of two or three bright yellow lemon wedges submerged in a clear liquid, their pale white pith edges forming diagonal bands against a dark background. The textured rinds are densely carpeted with tiny spherical gas bubbles that cling to every groove and pore of the fruit. Throughout the excerpt this effervescence remains active rather than static, as individual bubbles nucleate, swell into rounder shapes, and detach from the surface between moments. A few loose bubbles drift slowly through the dark fluid at the left edge of the frame, shifting position from one instant to the next. The lemon slices themselves hold their place, neither translating nor rotating, so the visible motion is confined to the bubbling liquid and the rind's fizzing coat. Shallow focus softens some of the larger spheres into bright bokeh while keeping the central wedge sharply detailed. The clip captures this steady, ongoing release of gas without showing how the fizzing began or when it subsides.
